content: कौमार {%a.%} (-री|{%f.%}) [कुमार-अण्] .²1 Juvenile, youthful, virgin, maidenly (of men and women); कौमारः पतिः a man who marries a virgin; कौमारी भार्या a virgin wife; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Mbh.</ls> on <ls>P. IV. 2. 13</ls>. .²2 Soft, tender. .²3 Belonging to the god of war; <ls>Māl. 1. 1</ls>. .²4 Of principal incarnation; स एव प्रथमं देवः कौमारं सर्गमास्थितः <ls>Bhāg. 1. 3. 6</ls>. .{@-री@} .²1 The wife of one who has not married another wife. .²2 The Śakti (power) of Kārtikeya. .{@-रम्@} .²1 Childhood (to the age of five). .²2 Maidenhood (to the age of sixteen), virginity; पिता रक्षति कौमारे भर्ता रक्षति यौवने <ls>Ms. 9. 3</ls>; देहिनोऽस्मिन् यथा देहे कौमारं यौवनं जरा <ls>Bg. 2. 13</ls>. .{@-(ब्रह्म)चारिन्@} {%a.%} abstinent, chaste; <ls>Ks. 66. 155</ls>.
